output.title: Renewal timestamp metric help text corrected; metric may be scraped
output.content: The fix corrects only the help text of `certmanager_certificate_renewal_timestamp_seconds`, which now says it is Unix epoch time rather than relative to expiration. The environment's values set `prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled`, so cert-manager metrics are plausibly scraped. The metric's values are not described as changing. Inspect any dashboards or alerts that interpret this metric as relative to expiry, since only the documentation is stated to change.
